title: Machine Learning in Quantitative Finance
text:
Ebube Anozie
PhD Student in Applied Mathematics
University of Colorado Boulder




This project investigates the application of machine learning methods to quantitative-finance problems. Throughout the semester, different machine learning techniques will be applied to financial data and evaluated from both computational and quantitative perspectives.




How effectively can machine learning methods identify useful patterns in financial market data?




Throughout the project, I will investigate:

Regression
Clustering
Dimensionality reduction
Ensemble methods
Other machine learning methods introduced in CSCI 5612




The goal is to understand not only how these models perform, but also how machine learning can be used as a tool for quantitative financial analysis.




I am a PhD student in Applied Mathematics at the University of Colorado Boulder. My research interests include quantitative finance, mathematical modeling, numerical methods, and machine learning.
